question: The ratio of the ages of a mother and a daughter after 20 years will be 15 : 8 and the ration of their ages 8 years ago was 8 : 1. What is the ratio of their current ages?
solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of ages of a mother(M) and a daughter(D) after 20 years = 15 : 8

Ratio of ages of a mother(M) and a daughter(D) 8 years ago = 8 : 1

**Calculation:**

According to question,

(M + 20)/(D + 20) = 15/8

8 × (M + 20) = 15 × (D + 20)

8M + 160 = 15D + 300

8M – 15D = 300 – 160 

8M – 15D = 140 ----(i)

(M – 8)/(D – 8 ) = 8

M – 8 = 8 × (D – 8)

M – 8 = 8D – 64

M – 8D = 8 – 64

M – 8D = – 56 ----(ii)

After multiplying equation (ii) by 8 and subtracting it from equation (i), we get

8 × (M – 8D) – (8M – 15D) = 8 × (– 56) – 140 

8M – 64D – 8M + 15D = – 448 – 140 

– 49D = – 588 

D = 588 / 49 

D = 12

And M – 8D = – 56

M – 8 × 12 = – 56

M = 96 – 56 

M = 40

Ratio of their present ages = M/D = 40/12

∴ The ratio of their present ages is **10 : 3.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

7 ratio = 20 + 8 = 28 years

So, 1 ratio = 28/7 = 4 years

The ratio of their present ages

15 × 4 - 20 : 8 × 4 - 20

⇒ 60 - 20 : 32- 20

⇒ 40 : 12 = 10 : 3

**∴ The ratio of their present ages is 10 : 3.**
